messages:
maria: Heads-up — prototyping an "adaptive logstream" idea. Goal: tie per-route sampling to route cost + tenant quota + transient error-rate, and show per-route sample rate in Console. Want quick feedback before I file an RFC.

owen: curious — how do you plan to handle PII? embeddings/attachments are the tricky bits.

jess: console UX thought: a small per-route card showing current sample_rate, last_adjustment_reason (cost|error|quota), and a PII-risk score (low/med/high). Default: inspect button disabled, enable via short-lived debug token that we surface in the card.

kamal: HMAC pseudonymization seems reasonable for most fields, but note HMAC is reversible if key leaked. We should define rotation policy and a breakglass workflow (audit-only unmasking via IR).

alex-legal: +1 on cautious approach. Please include threat model: what data class we allow in sampled payloads, who can request unmask, and retention TTL. Also, capture the process for key custodianship (KMS/HSM).

maria: proposal sketch (config example):
```json
{
  "routes": [
    {
      "pattern": "/v1/generate",
      "base_sample": 0.01,
      "max_sample": 0.10,
      "adjusters": ["cost_weighted","error_rate_burst"],
      "pii_policy": "hmac:rot30d",
      "debug_token_ttl_secs": 3600
    }
  ],
  "global": {
    "quota_backoff_threshold": 0.8,
    "quota_min_sample": 0.001
  }
}
```

maria: runtime behaviour: baseline 1% sampled. If route cost/latency spikes OR error-rate detects anomaly, sampler can temporarily rise up to max_sample (10%) for 5m windows; sampling decisions recorded with opaque fingerprint (sha256 HMAC) for dedupe.

own: two questions: 1) how do we surface the exposure metric without leaking counts? 2) can tenants opt out per-route?

jess: surface exposure as a normalized score (0-100) derived from token-exposure-weighted-sum; show only relative change. Tenants can opt out per-route — Console toggle that flips sampling to 0 and logs an audit event.

kamal: implementable notes: need a fast in-memory circuit to stop bumping samples for routes that hit tenant quota; also ensure we don't double-count when prefix-KV caching changes token counts.

maria: rollout plan: dogfood on internal org -> small canary (5% of routes) -> telemetry check (latency, cost delta, PII-risk metric) -> gradual ramp. Also add a "safety cutoff" so if cost delta > X or PII-risk delta > Y we auto rollback.

alex-legal: please add a short doc we can review before canary. We need to see sample retention, pseudonymization algo, and unmask audit flow.

deploy-bot: Integration tests for sampler feature queued (job id: 98765). ETA: ~2h.

jess: UX todo: add an inline explain link on the per-route card describing what "PII-risk" means and link to legal doc. Also add an action: Request-Inspect -> creates short-lived debug token + audit event.

maria: next actions: I'll draft RFC + brief threat model doc. Owen, want to own the backend sampler tests? Kamal can you outline key-rotation + breakglass ops? Jess will prototype Console card. Alex-legal can we try to meet Thurs for review?

own: yes, i'll take the backend tests.

kamal: will sketch key rotation + IR steps.

alex-legal: Thurs works. Ping me when RFC link is up.

maria: thanks everyone — will post RFC link later today.
